pkgmetadata.longdescription: Swift compiler and toolchain, ported from GURU. 5.10.1 is the last release that can be built from C++ with a three-stage Clang bootstrap. 6.3.3 needs a host Swift (5.10.1 or an installed 6.3). Toolchains live under /usr/lib*/swift-* and eselect-swift owns /usr/bin/swift.

use.flag: Build against llvm-runtimes/libcxx as the default C++ runtime instead of GCC's libstdc++.

slots.slot: The Swift 5 language, compiler, and tooling.
